limitations: Plan geometry only: heights, thicknesses and elevations are parameters; elements built from defaults are flagged in `assumptions`.
Wall / beam / duct / pipe lines are treated as centre-lines with a rectangular section; double-line walls will be doubled — draw or map one centre-line per wall.

Doors / windows are placed from the drawn symbols and cut into the nearest wall; swing, frames, hardware, reinforcement, MEP fittings and multiple storeys are not generated. Devices are positioned in plan only — mounting heights are parameters.
Polygons with holes are not supported; large concave footprints (>250 vertices) use an approximate cap triangulation in the GLB (IFC stays exact).
Every element is needs_review — an engineer must verify before contractual use.
